title: RunnerTask
description: What the treatment identity is allowed to see of a task: the question, and nothing else. The authored facets, the fixed queries and both probes stay in the steward's copy -- handing a selector a decomposition of the question that P0 never received would make any measured advantage an artifact of the harness rather than of the P1 mechanism. The separation is a file the runner cannot read, not a field it is asked not to look at.

deployment_pins.description: Permitted only if these exact bytes also appear in the P0 task prompt; otherwise this is extra planning information for one arm.
